notes.title: VERSION 1.3.0
notes.content:
- pickups better balanced (no more ammo without weapons)
- fix for BFG ammo
- fix for weapon sfx vanishing
- Some fixes in enemy shooting
- Added option to stop auto switching of weapon on pickup
- Ladder issues finally fixed
- Fixed overall scorring issue where it wasn't taking into account all game modes
- Addition of general ammo pickup which reloads current weapon
- Mini Map rendering improved
- Numerous other small fixes

- weapon persistence fixed again

- fix for enemies on map going wrong after a while
- fix for stacking pickups

- pickups balance adjusted
- pistol accuracy fixed
- pickup sound fix
-fix damage if you 'jump' into the water
- tweek to extra lives so won further apart as the game progresses
-send high score if exit level using menu

- brighter multiplier pickup
